dict.string: Mewrk opens projects in your Desktop folder and runs the commands and agent tools you start there.
Mewrk opens projects in your Documents folder and runs the commands and agent tools you start there.
Mewrk opens projects in your Downloads folder and runs the commands and agent tools you start there.
Mewrk opens projects on removable volumes and runs the commands and agent tools you start there.
Mewrk opens projects on network volumes and runs the commands and agent tools you start there.
Mewrk connects to SSH machines, model servers such as Ollama or LM Studio, and development servers on your local network.
Programs you run in Mewrk, such as scripts in the terminal, may ask to control other apps.
Programs you run in Mewrk may use the microphone.
Programs you run in Mewrk may use the camera.
Programs you run in Mewrk may use Bluetooth.
